en: If there existed a time machine, I would visit the future, but if scientists invent one in the future, [[historians]] [[will document]] [[it]] as revolutionary.
me: If there existed a time machine, I would visit the future, but if scientists invent one in the future,
easy: if scientists invent one in the future
If there existed a time machine, I would visit the future
타임머신이 존재한다면(exist(존재하다)) 나는 미래를 방문할 것이다(visit(방문하다)).
요약: 타임머신이 정말 발명되면 역사가들이 혁명적이라 기록할 것이다.
notes: if + 현재시제 → 주절 will: 실제로 일어날 수 있는 조건. would document ✕ → will document ○
한 문장에 if가 둘이면 절마다 따로 판단 (앞은 상상 would, 뒤는 가능성 will).

en: Mark would have gotten a perfect score if he had solved the last question, a question that was part of a set covering the whole chapter.
me: if he had solved the last question, a question that was part of a set covering the whole chapter.
easy: Mark would have gotten a perfect score
if he had solved the last question
a question that was part of a set covering the whole chapter
그 단원 전체를 다루는(cover(다루다)) 문제 묶음의 일부였던 문제.
요약: 단원 전체를 다루는 마지막 문제를 풀었다면 만점이었을 것이다.
notes: 관계대명사절의 동사는 선행사에 수 일치: a question(단수) that was ○ / that were ✕
covering the whole chapter는 a set을 뒤에서 꾸미는 -ing ('~을 다루는').

en: [[The flowers]] in the painting [[look]] as if they were alive, as though the artist had captured a living moment forever.
key: 그림 속 꽃들은 살아 있는 것처럼 보인다.
me: as though the artist had captured a living moment forever.
easy: The flowers look as if they were alive
그 꽃들은 마치 살아 있는 것처럼 보인다(look(보이다)).
as though the artist had captured a living moment forever
마치 화가가 살아 있는 순간을 영원히 담아낸 것처럼(capture(포착하다)).
요약: 그림 속 꽃이 화가가 생생한 순간을 잡아 둔 듯 살아 보인다.
notes: as if / as though + 가정법: 보이는 때보다 앞선 일이면 had p.p. has captured ✕ → had captured ○
look + 형용사/as if절 = ~처럼 보이다 (2형식).

en: Stephanie would own a dog if she had a house with a bigger backyard, and [[she]] often [[visits]] [[animal shelters]] and [[dreams]] about adopting a puppy.
me: Stephanie would own a dog if she had a house with a bigger backyard, and
and dreams about adopting a puppy.
easy: She visits animal shelters and dreams
Stephanie would own a dog if she had a house with a bigger backyard
더 큰 뒷마당이 있는 집이 있다면 개를 키울 텐데(own(소유하다)).
요약: 개를 키우고 싶어서 보호소를 자주 찾고 입양을 꿈꾼다.
notes: and로 이은 동사는 같은 형태끼리: visits and dreams. dreaming ✕ → dreams ○
dream about + -ing: 전치사 뒤에는 -ing (about adopting).

en: The soup tasted as if the chef had forgotten to add some salt and pepper, and [[the dish]] [[would taste]] [[better]] if the chef added more spices.
me: The soup tasted as if the chef had forgotten to add some salt and pepper, and
if the chef added more spices.
easy: 그 요리는 더 맛있을 것이다(taste(~한 맛이 나다)).
if the chef added more spices
The soup tasted as if the chef had forgotten to add some salt and pepper
그 수프는 마치 요리사가 소금과 후추 넣는 것을 잊은 듯한 맛이었다(forget(잊다)).
요약: 양념을 더 넣으면 요리가 더 맛있어질 텐데.
notes: if + 과거형(added) → 주절 would + 동사원형 (지금 사실의 반대). would have tasted ✕ → would taste ○
taste + 형용사 = ~한 맛이 나다 (2형식).

en: If early humans had not used language, the business deal would have been impossible, which is why [[linguists]] [[suggest]] [[that societies value communication highly]].
key: 언어학자들은 사회가 의사소통을 중시해야 한다고 제안한다.
me: If early humans had not used language, the business deal would have been impossible, which is why
easy: Linguists suggest that societies value communication
언어학자들은 사회가 의사소통을 중시해야 한다고 제안한다(suggest(제안하다), value(중요하게 여기다)).
If early humans had not used language, the business deal would have been impossible
초기 인류가 언어를 쓰지 않았다면(use(쓰다)) 거래는 불가능했을 것이다.
요약: 언어가 없었으면 거래도 없었기에, 사회가 의사소통을 중시해야 한다는 제안.
notes: 제안·주장·요구·명령 동사(suggest, insist, demand 등) + that절 → (should) + 동사원형. 주어가 단수여도 -s를 안 붙인다. 예) He suggested that she go.
suggest that ~: that절 전체가 목적어.

en: If a person takes more risks, he or she will have more chances for success, even though [[people]] often [[talk]] about failure as if it were always a bad thing.
me: If a person takes more risks, he or she will have more chances for success, even though
about failure as if it were always a bad thing.
easy: as if it were always a bad thing
마치 그것이 늘 나쁜 일인 것처럼.
If a person takes more risks, he or she will have more chances for success
사람이 더 많은 위험을 감수하면(take risks(위험을 감수하다)) 성공할 기회가 더 많아질 것이다.
요약: 위험을 감수해야 성공 기회가 늘지만, 사람들은 실패를 늘 나쁘게만 말한다.
notes: as if + 과거형: is ✕ → were ○. it이 단수여도 가정법에서는 were를 쓸 수 있다
even though = 비록 ~이지만. 뒤에는 절(주어+동사)이 온다.

en: Jessie always enters her sister's room without knocking as if it were her own room, even though [[she]] [[has]] [[many rules]] to follow at home.
me: Jessie always enters her sister's room without knocking as if it were her own room, even though
many rules to follow at home.
easy: Jessie always enters her sister's room without knocking as if it were her own room
Jessie는 늘 마치 자기 방인 것처럼 노크 없이 언니 방에 들어간다(enter(들어가다)).
요약: 집에선 지킬 규칙이 많은데도 언니 방엔 노크 없이 들어간다.
notes: many + 셀 수 있는 복수명사 (many rules), much + 셀 수 없는 명사 (much water). much rules ✕
to follow at home은 rules를 뒤에서 꾸미는 말 ('따라야 할').

en: If I had the power to control the weather, I would make this rain stop, but if it rains again tomorrow, [[our picnic plans]] [[will definitely change]].
key: 우리 소풍 계획은 반드시 바뀔 것이다.
me: If I had the power to control the weather, I would make this rain stop, but if it rains again tomorrow,
easy: If I had the power to control the weather, I would make this rain stop
내가 날씨를 조종할 힘이 있다면(control(조종하다)) 이 비를 멈추게 할 텐데.
요약: 내가 날씨를 못 바꾸니, 내일 또 비가 오면 소풍 계획이 바뀐다.
notes: if + 현재시제(rains) → 주절 will: 내일 비 올 가능성은 실제 조건. would ✕ → will ○
make + 목적어 + 동사원형 = ~가 …하게 하다 (make this rain stop).

en: We wouldn't have won if some of our players had quit earlier this year, and [[our team]] [[performed]] much better than we expected this season.
me: We wouldn't have won if some of our players had quit earlier this year, and
much better than we expected this season.
easy: much better than we expected this season
이번 시즌에 우리가 예상한(expect(예상하다)) 것보다 훨씬 더 잘.
We wouldn't have won if some of our players had quit earlier this year
올해 초 선수 몇 명이 그만뒀더라면(quit(그만두다)) 우리는 이기지 못했을 것이다(win(이기다)).
요약: 선수들이 남아 있어서, 우리 팀은 예상보다 훨씬 잘했다.
notes: 비교급 강조는 much / far / even / still / a lot. very better ✕ → much better ○
very는 원급을 강조 (very good). 비교급 앞에는 쓰지 않는다.

en: If readers look at the story through another character's eyes, they will interpret it differently, and [[they]] [[would have understood]] [[the ending]] better if the author had explained the twist earlier.
me: If readers look at the story through another character's eyes, they will interpret it differently, and
better if the author had explained the twist earlier.
easy: They would have understood the ending
if the author had explained the twist earlier
If readers look at the story through another character's eyes, they will interpret it differently
독자가 다른 인물의 눈으로 이야기를 보면(look at(보다)) 다르게 해석할 것이다(interpret(해석하다)).
요약: 작가가 반전을 일찍 알려 줬다면 결말이 더 잘 이해되었을 것이다.
notes: would have p.p. ↔ if + had p.p. (과거 반대). explained ✕ → had explained ○
앞 절은 if 현재 → will(가능성), 뒤 절은 과거 상상. 절마다 따로 판단한다.

en: The team could have finished the project last week if they had had one more member, and [[they]] [[had]] [[a former employee]] who once worked on a similar project two years ago.
key: 그들에게는 전 직원이 한 명 있었다.
me: The team could have finished the project last week if they had had one more member, and
a former employee who once worked on a similar project two years ago.
easy: 그들에게는 전 직원이 한 명 있었다(have(가지다)).
who once worked on a similar project two years ago
2년 전에 비슷한 프로젝트에서 한때 일했던(work on(~에서 일하다)).
The team could have finished the project last week if they had had one more member
팀원이 한 명 더 있었더라면 지난주에 프로젝트를 끝냈을 수도 있다(finish(끝내다)).
요약: 팀원이 한 명 부족했는데, 비슷한 일을 해 본 전 직원이 있었다.
notes: 사람 + who: 대명사 she는 절을 이어 주지 못하고, 관계대명사 who는 이어 준다. she once worked ✕ → who once worked ○
had had = had(가졌다)의 과거완료. if they had had one more member = 한 명 더 있었더라면.
